name: Telegram Node Traffic Notify
description: Escalating Telegram alerts when a node's monthly traffic reaches configured thresholds (e.g. 80%, 90%, 100%). Reads each node's traffic limit directly from the database.
author: Antigravity

tg_chat_id.label: Admin Chat ID
tg_chat_id.description: The Telegram Chat ID or Group ID to send notifications to.

thresholds.label: Alert Thresholds (%)
thresholds.description: Comma-separated escalating thresholds. Each level triggers a separate notification. Example: 80,90,100
